minimumAcceptance.requires: exclusive native admission; current source manifest
minimumAcceptance.pass: validation successful; no script compile error

minimumAcceptance.case: Ordinary Game Master Arland usable scene
minimumAcceptance.requires: mod enabled; normal local GM/admin editor permission; stock GM scenario
minimumAcceptance.pass: loading overlay dismissed; usable GM camera; stock M998 positive control found and placed

minimumAcceptance.case: Actual editor inheritance and browser search
minimumAcceptance.requires: GM EDIT mode; normal content browser open; search Gepard; all relevant filters reset
minimumAcceptance.pass: stock registry retained; one default and one charcoal card with translated labels; no duplicate/missing card; screenshot

minimumAcceptance.requires: normal Vehicles/armored/modded and applicable faction filter; each selected from browser
minimumAcceptance.pass: each appears under relevant filters; both placed through native placing component public action; server acknowledgement and actual entities visible; screenshot; direct SpawnEntityPrefab does not qualify

minimumAcceptance.requires: ordinary US catalog present and controlled factionless GM fixture with same editor path
minimumAcceptance.pass: exactly one default and charcoal in both; catalog spawner path preserved

minimumAcceptance.requires: fresh1.0.2 package; source addon unmounted; separate QA addon only if needed
minimumAcceptance.pass: resource inclusion/localization and actual browser/placement repeated; PAK hash pinned; no source fallback

minimumAcceptance.requires: all previous gates pass; preserve actual1.0.1 asset fields/media; existing authenticated publisher session
minimumAcceptance.pass: single update submission; upload and processing success; correct item/version; public/in-game latest evidence or explicit visibility blocker

scriptedPublicApiNotes.placing: SCR_PlacingEditorComponent.CreateEntity(ResourceName,SCR_EditorPreviewParams,...) invokes native permission/budget/registry/server path; a successful request is not by itself entity placement proof
scriptedPublicApiNotes.distinction: Programmatic public browser actions must be labelled programmatic. Physical card selection requires supported native UI or a human; screenshots and final placed objects remain required.

baselineControl: Record1.0.1 failure/absence using same normal-browser route where feasible; do not overwrite release1.0.1.
stopRules: placement denied or no server acknowledgement
